name: Champion Building Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Champion Building Materials Co., Ltd., along with its affiliated companies, specializes in the production and distribution of various ceramic goods, stone items, fire-resistant substances, and other chemical products. The enterprise is structured into three main operational divisions: the Tiles Business, the Chinese Business, and an 'Other' segment. Its extensive product portfolio features a wide array of tiles, encompassing floor, wall, polished, slate, and specialized functional varieties, as well as alternatives to natural stone materials. Additionally, the firm is involved in investment activities, the manufacturing and commercialization of premium sanitary porcelain, and trades in raw minerals such as kaolinite, magnet, feldspar, and silica sand. Beyond this, Champion Building Materials fabricates cement, metal structures, and various building components, while also providing agency-related services. The company further undertakes the wholesale distribution of construction materials. Champion Building Materials maintains a significant international footprint, with operations spanning across Asia, the United States, Australia, and other global markets. Established in 1972, its corporate headquarters are situated in Miaoli County, Taiwan.
